name: frog-oxide-studio-site
description: Landing site for Frog Oxide Studio

scripts.minify: npx terser site-shell.js -c -m -o site-shell.min.js && npx cleancss -o styles.min.css styles.css && npx html-minifier-terser index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-optional-tags --minify-css false --minify-js false -o index.min.html
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check requests.js && node --check reviews.js
